description.value: Study for a magazine or book cover, likely referencing the French writer Étienne (Stéphane) Mallarmé. Across the top, in blue serif type: MALLARME. Above the last letter “e”, a blue star in place of an acute accent. The right half of the first letter “m” is in black. Below, red and black dots arranged in an amoeba-like shape. One red dot at center is surrounded by a larger black circle. A second red dot at right is surrounded by a black circular outline. A section of dots at bottom left are surrounded by a quadrilateral in black outline.

legal.credit: Gift of Mrs. E. McKnight Kauffer

medium.value: Brush and black and blue gouache
